title: Maximum Non Negative Product In A Matrix
description:
You start at the top-left cell of `grid` and may move only right or down. Find the maximum product along a path to the bottom-right cell. Return the product modulo `10^9 + 7`; if every path has a negative product, return `-1`.

## Examples

```text
Input: grid = [[-1, -2, -3], [-2, -3, -3], [-3, -3, -2]]
Output: -1
```

```text
Input: grid = [[1, -2, 1], [1, -2, 1], [3, -4, 1]]
Output: 8
```

```text
Input: grid = [[1, 3], [0, -4]]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= grid.length, grid[i].length <= 15`
- `-4 <= grid[i][j] <= 4`
- All rows have the same length.
